scenario: Point-in-interval type match per LINT.3.1.3 — `t in i` requires the point and the interval to have matching element types. Pin: `Time in Interval<Date>` rejects with DS_VALIDATE_TYPE_MISMATCH.
rules_ds:
schema Check scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    fired_at: Time mutable
    range_start: Date mutable
    range_end: Date mutable

rule trig:
    Check c where c.fired_at in (c.range_start .. c.range_end)
->
    log info "x"
